tasks.title: New reference evidence only
tasks.acceptance: Use existing reference index and exact frame hashes. Block until a vision model passes actual validation; hypotheses are not approved preferences.

tasks.title: Persona existing queue regression checks
tasks.acceptance: Actual allowlisted tests pass in the isolated checkout; no merge or publication.

tasks.title: Source-backed editorial shortlist
tasks.acceptance: At most ten proposals and five independently verified topics. Block without verified source-fetch capability. Local model claims alone are not evidence.

tasks.title: Cream Editorial draft packages and Reel scripts
tasks.acceptance: Target two actual carousels and three scripts only with sufficient verified sources, permitted assets and approved current Cream style. Missing capabilities block; never invent successful production.

tasks.title: Actual Instagram and TikTok observations
tasks.acceptance: Authorized adapter and confirmed canonical publication IDs; missing metrics remain unknown, not zero. Never treat inflated follower counts as active audience.
